data.name: BrownDogGames
data.detailed_description:
About This Game

BrownDogGames is a zombie-infested nightclub that doubles as my personal game hub. Fight your way through the undead while listening to my original music, then head through different doors to jump into a growing collection of completely different games.

Each door leads to a different experience, including a Rolling Ball Game, Racing Game, Flashlight Game, Horror Mouse Click Game, Platform Game, VR Game, Skate Game, Basement Game, and Flying Game. More games and more doors will be added whenever I feel like making them.

Features

Explore a zombie-infested nightclub that acts as the central hub for every game. Shoot your way through the undead before choosing a door that leads to a completely different adventure. Every game offers its own gameplay style, from racing and platforming to horror, flying, VR, and more. The entire experience is backed by an original soundtrack featuring music written by the developer, and the collection continues to grow as new games, ideas, and experiments are added over time.

Developer's Note

I built BrownDogGames because I wanted somewhere to store my music, experiment with game ideas, and cure boredom.

I'm not arsed if anyone plays it.

I'm not arsed if anyone likes it.

If you enjoy it, brilliant.

If you don't, that's fine. Go play something else instead of telling me about it.

This isn't a project built around review scores or chasing trends. It's my game, my music, and my time, and I'll keep adding whatever I feel like adding, whenever I feel like adding it.

Now grab a weapon, clear the nightclub, pick a door, and see where it takes you.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains cartoon-style violence involving zombie enemies. Players can use weapons and melee attacks to fight and defeat zombies throughout the game.

The game also contains frequent strong language, horror themes, and dark comedic content. Some levels take place in nightclub environments and may contain references to alcohol consumption.

The game does not contain nudity, sexual content, sexual assault, self-harm, or graphic gore.
